[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3492360/Agent_Dunoz/]ADD TO WISHLIST[/url]

Hardcore Sci-Fi Cyberpunk Text RPG
This is not just a game—it’s a test of your decisions, tactics, and resilience. Every choice you make is irreversible. There are no Save-Load options. You live with the consequences of your actions.

This single-player RPG immerses you in a gripping experience of growth and survival. Develop unique attributes, master various weapons, and refine your skills as you navigate a world where every decision shapes your fate.

notes.title: Space Killer V2 Survival mode
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735463/ad91a84953db3515c53b37bed0f91c0773df46e2.jpg[/img]
[b]SPACE KILLER V2[/b]
We are pleased to present to you a new update in which we have added a survival mode to the story mode.
Now when you buy the game, you'll have 2 games in 1.
Survival mode features:
To complete the mode, you need to survive the onslaught of aliens for 20 minutes and destroy the final Boss.
Each level will make you stronger, allowing you to upgrade your 17 Ship Upgrades.
You have 17 ship upgrades available.
At the start of each level, you can choose the ship's Super Skill and basic weapon.
You must search for new weapons in boxes by hacking them, and you will find support modules by destroying medium killer ships.
Throughout the game, you will have the opportunity to upgrade weapons and receive additional Strength Enhancement cards.
[b]You will also find 3 unique items that provide:[/b]
[list]
[*] Magnet (attracts all resources and experience)
[*] Freeze (freezes all enemies)
[*] Explosion (deals damage to all enemies)
[/list]

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44735463/f7a7346462c1e7c70162e7aabafbb7e797904403.jpg[/img]
List of changes 1.1.0.1:
1. The card for increasing experience has been corrected, it gave more additional experience than it had.
2. Added Turkish language.
3. Added a link to the discord channel in the main menu of the game
4. The logic for generating items has been redesigned, now items of lower rarity will be generated with lower values. Now the higher the rarity of the item, the better the parameters it will have. This change affects only the new items you receive, the old ones will remain unchanged.
